    PbcsAppDimension
    An "app dimension" extends from a normal PbcsDimension object and is slightly specialized with additional methods such as which plans (cubes) it is valid for.
    PbcsApplication
    Models a PBCS application such as a Planning or an HFM application.
    PbcsApplication.PlanTypeConfiguration
    The number of overloads of PbcsApplication.getPlanType(String) started to proliferate, so there is now a generic configuration object where the plan definition is specified and then passed to the PbcsApplication.getPlanType(PlanTypeConfiguration) method.
    PbcsAppType
    Models the application type.
    PbcsDimension
    Represents a dimension in terms of a Data Management dimension (as opposed to a particular instance of a dimension in an application/plan type).

    Represents a job definition that exists in the application.

    Represents a particular plan type (cube) contained as part of a PbcsApplication.

    PbcsPlanType.ExportCallback
    A callback that can be used with the PbcsPlanType.export(PbcsPov, String, DimensionMembers, ExportCallback) method for exporting a flat set of data from a cube.
    PbcsPlanType.ImportDataOptions
    Represents all the options that can be used on the importDataSlice REST endpoint.
    PbcsPlanType.ImportDataResult
    Represents the results of importing data to the plan/cube.
    PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache
    A member dimension cache is a simple cache that caches the dimension for member names.
    PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver
    An elaboration of the PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache that offers more sophistication than just resolving the dimension for a given member.
    PbcsPlanType.RetrieveOptions
    Options for performing a retrieve.
    PbcsPov
    Represents a POV (i.e., a single fully qualified cell address).
